intent: Increased sensor size to 0.016 m to improve line detection and reduce line loss. Reduced wheel track to 0.12 m to enhance turning agility and responsiveness. Increased body length to 0.20 m to improve stability and off-track tolerance. Sensor positions remain balanced across the front for good coverage. Mass and wheel radius unchanged to maintain stability and speed balance. Expect improved line coverage, fewer line loss events, better turning, and increased stability to reduce stalls and off-track failures.
rationale: The evidence from the last race shows line loss and stalling issues, indicating insufficient sensor coverage and turning agility. The integrator feedback supports increasing sensor size to 0.016 m, reducing wheel track to 0.12 m, and increasing body length to 0.20 m. These changes should improve line detection, turning responsiveness, and stability. Sensor positions remain balanced to maintain good line sensing coverage. Mass and wheel radius are kept the same to preserve stable handling and speed characteristics. This geometry aims to provide a better platform for the integrator to develop a more effective controller, reducing line loss and stalls, and improving overall race progress and completion.
